<!--''''''-->(Japanese: '''ソルト''' ''Salt'') is a recurring character who appears in ''[[Pokémon Horizons: The Series]]''. He is the father of [[Ult]] and was the one to give him the [[Dusk Ball]] containing {{p|Dragonite}}. According to [[Team Dragon Rampage]], he is also a famous {{tc|Dragon Tamer}}.

==History==
[[File:Young Ult.png|thumb|250px|left|Salt giving his son the Dusk Ball]]
===Pre-series===
==={{aniseries|HZ}}===
In a flashback in ''[[HZ107|Friends as Two, Me and You]]'', he was shown giving Ult his {{p|Dragonite}}, telling it that when the day comes that Ult fights to protect someone else, that is when it fights on his behalf.

In ''[[HZ113|Mega Evolution - Ult]]'', it was revealed that Ult lived part of his life homeless in the alleys of [[Lumiose City]]. Salt's current whereabouts and status are unknown.

|desc=As revealed in ''[[HZ107|Friends as Two, Me and You]]'', {{p|Dragonite}} once used to belong to Salt and was later given to his son.

In ''[[HZ106|The Dusk Ball That Wouldn't Open]]'', reacting with Ult's willingness to fight for others, Dragonite appeared before him for the first time and quickly defeated [[Indi]] and [[Rubina]]'s {{p|Darmanitan}}. In the [[HZ107|next episode]], when Ult called for its strength in order to protect the ones he cares about, Dragonite appeared once again. This time, it Mega Evolved, allowing it to overpower the opposing {{p|Rabsca}}'s {{m|Gravity}} and defeat them. Alongside [[Roy]]'s Mega {{TP|Roy|Lucario}}, it defeated the Explorers duo's {{form|Darmanitan|Zen Mode}} Darmanitan.

Dragonite's known moves are {{m|Dragon Rush}}, {{m|Hyper Beam}}, and {{m|Twister}}.}}
